method: Actual first-round Responses API request with production identity prompt and exact direction guidance/voice terminal schemas; representative ordinary tools declared for routing only; synthetic transcripts and contexts, with two user-reported examples tested privately and described here. No tools called outside the model, no chat records. Alternate sync/stream; store=false, parallel_tool_calls=false, 512 token output budget. attend_incomplete denotes attend selected but generation exceeded artificial budget. Luna old results from .35, new 48 tested using the .35 classifier class and policy. Parallelism 4 Terra, 3 Luna. Not an end-to-end TTS/ASR benchmark.
